# Level card image prompts

One prompt per level, in the style of the India cards (Mumbai Docks, Varanasi Ghats).

* Generate at 4:3 landscape (1448x1086 or 1024x768), PNG.
* Save it exactly at the `save as` path (replaces the placeholder). The game shows it on the card automatically.
* Same list as a spreadsheet: `level_card_prompts.csv`.
* Regenerate this file after changing card titles: `python Tools/make_level_card_prompts.py`.


## Asia - China

### 1. Beijing Bites

Save as: `Assets/Project Data/Game/Resources/World/asia/china/level_1.png`

```
Bright, cheerful, highly detailed digital painting in a polished casual mobile-game style (soft painterly rendering, clean readable shapes, glossy highlights, rich saturated colours), wide 4:3 landscape, 1448x1086. The scene is "Beijing Bites" in China: the city or place in the name with its most famous landmark clearly visible behind, and in the mid-ground a charming, inviting little eatery, stall or terrace serving the local signature food this name suggests, with colourful awnings and a little steam rising. One or two small Chinese flags placed naturally (on a boat, stall or pole). Sunny day: vivid blue sky with big fluffy white clouds, bright sunlight, soft shadows. The real place must be instantly recognisable: accurate, famous architecture or nature of this exact location as the big clear centrepiece in the middle of the picture, seen from a classic postcard viewpoint. Lively but uncluttered: a few tiny people far away (no close-up faces), local details that belong there. Keep the edges calm (the card crops a little on every side). No text, no letters, no signs with words, no logos, no watermark, no border, no UI.
```
